title: TypePHP v0.8.0: Schema Composition, Conditional Parameters, and Smart Diagnostics
excerpt: Celebrating the release of v0.8.0! This release brings array shape composition, discriminator-aware union diagnostics, conditional parameters, and a zero-I/O production mode to the PHP ecosystem.

title: When Static Analyzers Teach You the Wrong Way: The Dogma of Variance and the Pursuit of Working QA
excerpt: An exploration of why static analyzers sometimes force developers into anti-patterns to satisfy theoretical purity, Cecil Curry's insight from Beartype, and how runtime type checking restores sanity.

title: From Sluggish to Blazing Fast: How I Made TypePHP 90x Faster and Uncovered 400+ 'DocBlock Lies' on Shopware 6
excerpt: A deep-dive into how profiling TypePHP on Shopware 6 took my test execution from 3 hours 7 minutes down to 2 minutes 9 seconds, and how runtime checking exposed over 400 dynamic DocBlock lies that PHPStan Level MAX couldn't catch.

title: How to Enforce Runtime Generics on Third-Party Collections Libraries (Doctrine, Ramsey, Laravel Collections) with TypePHP
excerpt: A step-by-step tutorial on making third-party collections (Doctrine ArrayCollection, Ramsey Collection) reified and strictly type-checked at runtime using path whitelisting and TypePHP extensions.

title: The Death of the 'DocBlock Lie': Introducing TypePHP and Runtime Reified Generics in Pure PHP
excerpt: An introduction to TypePHP: how it uses Load-Time Weaving via native StreamWrappers to enforce PHPDoc contracts at runtime, eliminates the "DocBlock Lie", and brings true Reified Generics to modern PHP without transpilers or C-extensions.
